shortDescription: Eco-Dome Midrealm, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: The Midrealm Post inside Eco-Dome Midrealm, where Gahruj handles the disputed Consortium surveying-equipment contract. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
